component.name: ChipWave Studio
component.summary: Free music DAW and tracker with built-in synths

description.p: ChipWave Studio (formerly ChipWave Tracker) is an OctaMED-inspired music tracker: a fast keyboard-driven pattern editor with a built-in synth, Voice instrument, macro-knob generators, CLAP plugin hosting, an arranger, a mixer with effects and WAV/MP3 export.

Live recording: pressing Record opens a REC block at once that grows with the playhead with no length limit, draws notes as you play with a fade-in, and settles into a normal clip on Stop. Quick modulation on every knob: a dot opens a popover with LFO, Envelope, Random, Velocity and Mod wheel, plain-word Speed, Length and Attack sliders, Sync to tempo, a live shape preview and one Movement list per instrument. A tidier instrument header, a backlit mint LCD, and a keyboard icon for computer-keys-to-notes that is on by default without a MIDI keyboard.

Bigger, resizable and movable Timeline tracks: taller rows by default; drag a track's bottom edge to resize it (double-click resets), Ctrl+wheel over the track headers or Alt+wheel resizes every track; drag a track header up or down, or use the track pie's Move up / Move down, to reorder tracks with their clips, sound and mix; a much stronger selected-track highlight in every theme.

Easier-to-read text: the bundled Atkinson Hyperlegible Next and Mono fonts and one type scale with nothing under 10 pt; Settings › Look has UI scale and Text size (90 to 150 %), and the OS display scale is respected on Windows, Wayland and X11; layouts fit at 1366 × 768 and at 150 %; higher text contrast in Dark; an imported instrument becomes the active one; Timeline clips share one gradient across all tracks.

Generators panel with Chords, Melody and Bass tabs, a movable panel and a big Preview pad; Write to timeline keeps the track's sound; an LCD toolbar with colour presets and a Master popover; context-aware track pies and a New track pie; empty tracks without an instrument, Song / Master at the bottom; a compact Rack card with an effect drop box and double-click side tabs; Clip Arranger stop toggle; Shift+arrow note nudge; no recovery prompt after a clean exit.

The new Rack: the instrument and then its effects in one sideways row under the Timeline, with side tabs for bypass, remove and collapse, a highlighted selected device, Delete and Ctrl+D with undo, a few chosen knobs per instrument with Advanced for the rest, a Drum Kit pad picker, racks shown in place and Save rack; a Notes | Rack switch in the lower panel; Browser Instruments lists instruments, with presets on the card; CI and test fixes.

StringWave, a new built-in string-ensemble instrument with presets; a violet look for ChipWave's own instruments; track pie Add rings (Drum pattern, instrument, kit); Drum Kit kits with starter grooves; piano roll ruler paste and play markers; CLAP plugin fixes; studio knobs, a steady panel height, Play / Stop toggle, metronome and count-in, Keys to Notes, a simpler Browser and visual fixes.

Racks and Nested Device Chains: a device tree under the Timeline, Add Device, Split for parallel paths, layered rack instruments, Save Custom Rack and My Racks; piano roll copy and paste; the Automation tab only with the Tracker; new demo song Oceans 11 (music by Martin Galway).

One workflow: persistent Timeline layout, one drop system with preview, snap and an overlap question, Clip Arranger launcher clips with per-track launch and linked copies, the track's instrument on a header click, pies for clips, launcher clips and drum patterns, clip names and colours; themed title bar on Windows; ChipWave Instruments in the Browser.

WaveForge polyphonic synth; Drum Kit instrument with step sequencer, groove generator and Add to track; new notes play the track's instrument; split preview, chord replace, track pie Add menu; consistency and stability fixes.

Timeline with clips, piano roll, automation lanes and audio clips; VST3 and plugin effects; the Browser; Devices; Wave and Grid generators; Advanced Edit; starts on an empty song; faster audio engine.
Renamed from ChipWave Tracker to ChipWave Studio. Transpose buttons and Edit › Transpose.
